disposition.description: Infer checkable requirements from observable outcomes even when the guide does not call them automated. Use supported_pre_submit for static or other bounded checks that reliably complete within 60 seconds, and supported_post_submit for longer background evaluation. Use the matching capability gap when the required implementation is unavailable; a gap keeps the proposal warning-ready but blocks activation. Use human_review only for retained historical evidence only. Newly generated requirements are limited to PRE and POST checks, exact platform coverage and check-definition blockers. Do not propose human-review or project-management policy. Revision explanation, rerun evidence and objective preservation remain separately checkable work requirements, not lifecycle. A guide_blocker requires guide_blocked and no artifact policy.
